why: The truth backs the finding's main claim. In the 14 months where 115 sent 9 or more new quotes, 37.7% of other quoters' quotes were lost because the buyer had already decided (reason 'late'), against 21.2% in months with no 115 quotes (t424, t425). Nothing in the truth marks 115 as a weak quoter: skill 0.987 against 0.995 for estimator 109 (t426), and their estimate biases look like everyone else's (t422). That matches the effect in P1, slow quotes losing work, and one of its causes, the estimator vacancies. But the key says the delay comes mostly from the twice-a-week inbox and requests missing information, and the finding never mentions either, so it covers only the secondary part of P1.
